definitions.gloss: to warm up, to get warm
definitions.explanation: To become warm; to be warmed (intransitive).

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{暖|あたた}まって⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
お⟦{風呂|ふろ}→風呂：14633_furo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{暖|あたた}まろう。
examples.english: Let's take a bath and warm up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{暖|あたた}まる⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧。

notes:
{暖|あたた}まる is the intransitive form meaning to warm up.

TRANSITIVE PAIR:
- {暖|あたた}まる (v.i.): to warm up
- {暖|あたた}める (v.t.): to warm (something)

KANJI VARIATION:
- {暖|あたた}まる: warm (temperature/room)
- {温|あたた}まる: warm (body/emotional)

Note: Godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし}).
